question: What API definition formats does Fern integrate with?
ground_truth: Fern integrates with OpenAPI (for REST & Webhook APIs), AsyncAPI (for WebSocket APIs), OpenRPC (for JSON-RPC APIs), gRPC (for RPC APIs), and Fern Definition (for REST, Webhook, & WebSocket APIs).

metadata.cited_context: Fern integrates with several API definition formats: OpenAPI (REST & Webhook APIs), formerly known as Swagger, is the most popular API definition format. AsyncAPI (WebSocket APIs) is a specification for defining event-driven APIs. OpenRPC (JSON-RPC APIs) is a spec for describing JSON-RPC 2.0 APIs. gRPC (RPC APIs) is a modern, open-source RPC framework developed by Google. Fern Definition (REST, Webhook, & WebSocket APIs) is our take on a simpler API definition format.
